feature_name: maintenance window and self-service maintenance management
summary: You can use the Google Cloud console to find and set maintenance windows and perform self-service maintenance on instances.
extended_definition: You can use the Google Cloud console to find and set maintenance windows and perform self-service maintenance on instances.

supporting_pages.title: About maintenance \_|\_ Memorystore for Valkey \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Default maintenance windows By default, Memorystore updates your instance in the following windows according to your instance's time zone: Weekday window (Monday to Friday): 10 PM to 6 AM Weekend window: Friday, 10 PM to Monday, 6 AM Gradual deployment strategy Memorystore for Valkey performs deployments with a progressively increasing scope, and at a rate that allows for failure detection early enough to mitigate any impact and establish stability confidence.

In this case, set your production instance's maintenance window to the following day and time: Day of the week : Sunday Start hour : 1 AM Upcoming maintenance notifications To ensure that you stay informed about maintenance events on your instance, set up email notifications about upcoming maintenance at least one week before maintenance is scheduled.

Configure your client application To configure your client application for the best performance and availability during maintenance, follow these steps: Use and configure your third-party client according to the guidance at Valkey client best practices to make sure that any scheduled maintenance doesn't impact the client application.
